Symbols:
  Q: Volumetric flow rate. [m^3/s] (computed)
  Q_{open}: Volumetric flow rate through the open pores. [m^3/s] (computed)
  Q_{blocked}: Volumetric flow rate through the blocked pores. [m^3/s] (computed)
  \Delta P: Transmembrane pressure. [Pa] (variable)
  \mu: Solution viscosity. [Pa s] (parameter)
  R_{m}: Clean membrane resistance. [m^-1] (parameter)
  A_{open}: Area of the membrane that remains uncovered at any given time. [m^2] (computed)
  A_{blocked}: Area of membrane blocked by protein aggregates. [m^2] (variable)
  R_{p}: Resistance of the protein deposit over a particular region of the membrane. [m^-1] (computed)
  \alpha: Pore blockage parameter. [m^2 kg^-1] (parameter)
  C_{b}: Bulk protein concentration. [g/L] (variable)
  m_{p}: Mass of the protein deposit per unit area. [g m^-2] (computed)
  f^{\prime}: Fraction of the proteins that contribute to the growth of the deposit. [-] (parameter)
  J_{blocked}: Filtrate flux through each region of the membrane. [m s^-1] (computed)
  R^{\prime}: Proportionality coefficient relating deposit hydraulic resistance to deposit mass per unit area. [m g^-1] (parameter)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - The initial deposit is partially permeable, allowing finite flow through blocked pores.
  - Pore coverage rate is proportional to convective protein‑aggregate flow rate.
  - Deposit hydraulic resistance is directly proportional to mass per unit area.
  - Specific protein layer resistance R' is constant during constant‑pressure filtration.

laws.description: Total filtrate flow is the sum of the flow through open and blocked pores.
laws.quote: The volumetric filtrate flow rate through the fouled membrane can thus be expressed as the sum of the flow rates through the open and blocked pores
laws.law_type_reason: This defines total flow as the sum of two component flow rates.

laws.description: Open-pore filtrate flow is computed from pressure, viscosity, clean membrane resistance, and open membrane area.
laws.quote: is easily evaluated in terms of the clean membrane resistance
laws.law_type_reason: This is a hydraulic flow relation that a rival model could replace.

laws.description: Blocked-pore filtrate flow is computed by integrating the local flow over the blocked membrane area.
laws.quote: The volumetric flow rate through the blocked pores is written as
laws.law_type_reason: This is a hydraulic flow relation integrated over the blocked area.

laws.description: The open membrane area decreases in proportion to convective protein-aggregate flow through the open pores.
laws.quote: The rate of pore coverage or blockage is assumed to be proportional to the convective flow rate of protein aggregates to the membrane surface.
laws.law_type_reason: It describes the rate of change of open membrane area as area is blocked.

laws.description: Protein-deposit mass per unit area grows in proportion to protein transported through each blocked membrane region.
laws.quote: The growth of the protein deposit over each blocked region of the membrane is assumed to be proportional to the convective transport of protein through that particular region
laws.law_type_reason: It gives the accumulation rate of deposited protein mass per unit area.

assumptions.text: Deposit growth is proportional to convective protein transport through each blocked region.

laws.description: Filtrate flux through each blocked membrane region is computed from pressure, viscosity, and the combined membrane and deposit resistance.
laws.quote: J_{blocked} is the filtrate flux through each region of the membrane
laws.law_type_reason: This is a hydraulic flux relation determined by pressure and local resistance.

laws.description: Deposit hydraulic resistance changes in proportion to the rate of deposited protein mass accumulation per unit area.

laws.law_type_reason: It gives the rate of change of deposit resistance through the accumulation rate of deposit mass.
